content.value_statement: Backend work can drift across APIs, data models, tests, and service boundaries. This skill organizes backend tasks with checklists, context packages, and integration handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Defines responsibilities for API, database, service, and context maintenance work.
Packages backend context for API, database, auth, integration, and testing skills.
Provides checklists for API design, database quality, security, and testing.
Describes event payloads for frontend API requests and backend readiness updates.
Sets success metrics for response time, coverage, query speed, and error rate.
limitations: It is a guidance document and does not execute commands or modify files by itself.
It depends on separate specialized skills that are not included in this package.
It does not provide concrete implementation templates for a specific framework.
Metrics and checklists need project-specific adjustment before enforcement.

use_cases.title: Plan API Work
use_cases.description: Break a backend feature into endpoint design, data changes, tests, and documentation tasks.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Frontend Requests
use_cases.description: Convert frontend API needs into backend contracts, readiness events, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Standardize Service Delivery
use_cases.description: Apply shared quality gates for security, performance, database integrity, and release readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Backend Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a small API change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-orchestrator to plan a backend feature for [feature]. Include endpoints, data changes, tests, and documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Skill Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate coordination across specialized backend skills.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-orchestrator to package context for [task]. Identify the best specialized skill, required inputs, success criteria, and handoff notes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Backend Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-orchestrator to review [backend change]. Check API behavior, database safety, security controls, tests, and performance targets.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate a Service Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination for a multi-service backend workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backend-orchestrator to coordinate [external service integration]. Include service boundaries, failure handling, auth, data contracts, tests, and rollout checks.

output_examples.input: Plan a users API that supports pagination, filtering, and authentication.
output: Endpoint design includes list, detail, create, update, and delete operations with versioned routes.
Database work includes user table review, filter indexes, and migration rollback planning.
Validation covers authentication, authorization, pagination limits, API tests, and documentation updates.

output_examples.input: Review whether a backend change is ready for frontend integration.
output: The API contract is checked for request fields, response format, errors, and CORS requirements.
Readiness depends on passing API tests, database integrity checks, security checks, and performance targets.
The handoff lists documentation updates, known limits, and the readiness event for frontend teams.
The plan separates service logic, authentication, retry handling, background jobs, and audit logging.
Testing includes unit tests, integration tests, contract tests, load tests, and security validation.
Release checks include rollback planning, sensitive data handling, and monitoring requirements.

best_practices: Start with API contracts and data ownership before assigning implementation work.
Keep security, migration rollback, and test requirements visible throughout the task.
Update backend documentation when endpoints, schemas, or integrations change.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the orchestrator as a framework-specific implementation guide.
Do not skip specialized skill handoffs for database, auth, integration, or testing work.
Do not accept backend changes without explicit validation against the quality checklists.

faq.question: What does this skill help coordinate?
faq.answer: It coordinates backend tasks across APIs, databases, services, integrations, tests, and documentation.

faq.question: Does it run backend commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a planning and coordination guide, not an executable script.

faq.question: Can it design API contracts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes API responsibilities, frontend handoff points, event examples, and validation criteria.

faq.question: Does it include database guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers schema design, migrations, indexes, integrity checks, rollbacks, backups, and query performance.

faq.question: How should teams use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Use it to structure prompts, assign backend work, review readiness, and keep quality gates consistent.

faq.question: What should be customized before use?
faq.answer: Customize endpoints, data models, service dependencies, performance targets, and project-specific standards.
